caption: AI drafts look polished, but facts, sources, and dates can be wrong. This seven-step prompts checklist helps you verify AI output before publishing. Save this as a quick workflow for future AI documents. Which prompt will you run first today? #AIatWork #Productivity #AIChecks #NaelBuildingBig

slides.title: Your AI draft looks polished
slides.body: The problem: AI drafts seem complete but facts, sources, and dates often mislead. Five prompts to verify before posting.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose accuracy
slides.body: Prompt: Diagnose accuracy. Input AI draft. Task: extract factual claims, mark supported vs. unsupported. Output: list of claims and status.

slides.title: 2. Verify sources
slides.body: Prompt: Verify sources. Input AI draft. Task: fetch each citation URL, assess credibility. Output: citations with credibility verdict.

slides.title: 3. Check citations
slides.body: Prompt: Check citations. Input AI draft. Task: compare quotes with cited lines, confirm exactness. Output: quotes and match status.

slides.title: 4. Confirm dates
slides.body: Prompt: Confirm dates. Input AI draft. Task: extract dates, verify against sources, flag incorrect dates. Output: date verification results.

slides.title: 5. Refine results
slides.body: Prompt: Refine results. Input AI draft. Task: produce a clean cite-ready version with verified sources and dates. Output: checklist-ready document.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Always treat AI drafts as drafts; verify facts, sources, and dates before publishing. Save this workflow and follow @naelbuildingbig.
